title: Stitching unraveled, zipper on bottom of pillow case
text:
Stitching unraveled, zipper on bottom of pillow case. 1st, the pillow cases open on the bottom and they only zip open about 7 inches. You cannot fit a pillow in there and the opening is in the wrong side.
2nd, the duvet zipper doesn't span the entire length of the bottom of duvet, and it was not centered. The right side was 6 inches longer (after the zipper) than the left.
3rd, all the stitching was unraveling.
This is cheap, thin, fragile, and a disgusting display of workmanship!
